insight: Bootstrapped from a Reddit post by two ex-Comcast developers, it hit $120M ARR before ever raising a Series A.
name: Runpod
tagline: GPU cloud for AI — on-demand instances and serverless inference.
description: Runpod is an AI developer cloud for renting GPUs on demand or running auto-scaling serverless inference endpoints. Serverless workers bill by the millisecond, scale to zero when idle, and advertise sub-200ms cold starts; on-demand Pods and multi-node Clusters cover training and long-running jobs. A Community Cloud tier offers cheaper, peer-sourced GPUs alongside the vendor-operated Secure Cloud.

modelSupport.notes: Raw GPU compute — deploy and serve any model or container you bring.

edge: Serverless GPU inference billed by the millisecond, scales to zero, plus a cheaper peer-sourced Community Cloud tier.
